jobs.title: Director Threat Intelligence
jobs.description:
Division:  Technology

Location:  Toronto, Winnipeg

IGM Financial Inc. is a leading wealth and asset management company in Canada, managing approximately $310 billion in assets as of December 31, 2025. It offers financial planning and investment services to over two million Canadians through IG Wealth Management and Mackenzie Investments.

Founded in 1926, IG Wealth Management is a key part of IGM's business model, providing comprehensive wealth management services to Canadian financial advisors and their clients.

With a vision to inspire financial confidence, IG Wealth Management is recognized as one of Manitoba’s Top Employers, Canada’s Top 100 Employers, and Best Diversity Employers, aiming to innovate the industry and support Canadians in achieving their financial goals.

Join our team to engage in continuous learning and skill development in a supportive environment. Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work environment, where you spend three days a week in the office, connecting, collaborating, and enjoying quality time with your amazing colleagues! Our Values: Be better; we strive for improvement in everything we do. Be accountable; we foster clarity and are empowered to act responsibly. Be a team; we are united to drive collective impact to achieve our goals.

Overall Job Purpose

Accountable for enterprise strategy, standards, and guardrails across security platform and infrastructure engineering, with a direct mandate to mature Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as day to day operating capabilities. Shapes policy enforcement, resolves systemic constraints across multiple teams, and influences senior stakeholders on investment, resilience, and risk trade-offs, translating enterprise considerations into actionable governance aligned to Technology standards.

Key Accountabilities

Enterprise Strategy, Standards, and Guardrails
Define and evolve enterprise platform and infrastructure standards spanning tooling, pipelines, shared services, automation, resilience, recoverability, and observability, and drive adoption across portfolios.
Serve as trusted advisor on the highest-complexity platform, infrastructure, and operational resilience issues across multiple teams.
Threat Intelligence Enablement
Own the enterprise standards for threat intelligence collection, enrichment, and dissemination so that intel drives compensating control recommendations for operators.
Translate threat intelligence into prioritized, evidence-based guardrails and detection requirements across the security ecosystem.
DevSecOps and Secure Delivery
Sponsor policy-as-code, automation, and knowledge automation practices so security controls are codified, machine-testable, and enforced within pipelines.
Define safe automation and CI/CD enablement patterns that embed security guardrails into build, test, deploy, and operate workflows.
Systemic Constraint Resolution
Resolve systemic platform and infrastructure constraints impacting delivery speed, reliability, security, capacity, stability, or recoverability across multiple teams.
Resilience, Incident, and Operational Readiness
Drive observability, resilience, and incident learning at enterprise scale, including telemetry, alerting, capacity, and DR readiness, to improve service maturity.
Influence, Investment, and Escalation Governance
Influence roadmap and investment decisions with evidence-based trade-offs on capability, risk, resilience, cost, and scalability.
Determine when initiatives require escalation due to enterprise or regulatory impact and ensure consistent engagement with architecture and risk forums.
Partner with senior stakeholders to align priorities and sequencing when constraints materially impact outcomes.
AI-Enabled Practices
Shape and sponsor AI-enabled platform and infrastructure strategy, including automation, predictive monitoring, and policy-as-code, aligned to security and governance.
People and Capability Uplift
Mentor senior ICs and strengthen capability uplift through communities of practice and standards forums.
Continuous Improvement
Identify recurring friction and enable durable fixes across the platform and infrastructure ecosystem.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Technology or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Extensive progressive experience delivering enterprise platform and infrastructure services and enablement.
Proven influence on standards, governance alignment, and risk-informed decisions across multiple teams.
Demonstrated leadership-by-influence with senior stakeholders and governance forums.
Deep expertise in automation, CI/CD enablement, observability, recoverability, and secure operations.
Ability to shape AI-enabled strategy and guardrails at scale.
Demonstrated depth in Threat Intelligence and DevSecOps as core operating disciplines.

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $149,500 - $192,500
which is determined based on skills, knowledge and experience and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for annual short-term incentive, health and well-being benefits, retirement and savings plan, paid time off and career development.

Benefits

COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION & RECOGNITION: competitive base salary, performance-weighted bonus, education/career support, option to join Employee Share Purchase Plan with employer matching component.
EMPLOYEE BENEFITS & INSURANCE: competitive health and dental coverage, flexible plan for you and your family and short-term & long-term disability plans.
RETIREMENT SAVINGS PROGRAMS: voluntary Defined Contribution Pension Plan
WORK LIFE BALANCE: paid volunteer days, competitive time off, including 10 wellness days off, WorkPerks discount program, hybrid & flex work arrangements.
INCLUSIVE CULTURE AND DIVERSITY: living our core values: Be a Team, Be Accountable, Be Better, engaging with community through Business Resource Groups (BRG communities are volunteer employee-led groups formed around a common interest, identity, or background).

IGM is a diverse workplace committed to doing business inclusively - this starts with having a representative workforce! We encourage applications from all qualified candidates that represent the diversity present across Canada – including racialized persons, women, Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, 2SLGBTQIA+ community, gender diverse and neurodiverse individuals, as well as all who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas.

IG is an accessible employer committed to providing a barrier- free recruitment experience. If you require an accommodation or this information in an alternate format at any stage of the recruitment process, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team who will work with you to meet your needs.

How to Apply: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and a cover letter detailing their qualifications and experience to https://www.ig.ca/en/careers

Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment: As part of our Talent Acquisition process, we may use artificial intelligence and automated tools to support activities such as candidate sourcing, application review, and interview scheduling. These tools support the recruitment process; all hiring decisions are made by people.

We thank all applicants for their interest in IG Wealth Management; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please apply before October 18 2026.

jobs.title: VP, Engagement Strategy
jobs.description:
About Us

At BGBx
, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

Position Overview

The VP, Engagement Strategy turns brand strategy into connected omnichannel engagement.
This senior leader defines how audience insight, behavioral science, content, media, CRM, field engagement, technology, and measurement work together across the customer journey. The VP leads clients and integrated teams from insight through activation and optimization, while helping grow BGBx's Engagement Strategy capability.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement & Omnichannel Strategy

Lead audience-centered, behaviorally informed omnichannel strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, payer, and other stakeholder audiences
Translate brand and business strategy into connected journeys, engagement architectures, channel roles, sequencing, triggers, and activation roadmaps
Define how content, media, CRM, field, social, experiential, and digital interactions work together to move audiences toward desired behaviors
Make clear strategic choices and tradeoffs that focus investment on the moments and interactions most likely to create impact

Audience, Content & Experience

Turn research, segmentation, behavioral data, cultural context, and market dynamics into actionable audience understanding
Identify the beliefs, motivations, barriers, decision pathways, and moments of receptivity that engagement must address
Shape content and experience strategy so each interaction has a clear role, purpose, call to action, and connection to what happens next
Maintain the strategic throughline as work moves from strategy into creative development, implementation, and optimization

Measurement & Optimization

Define engagement objectives, KPI frameworks, signal plans, and learning agendas
Design closed-loop approaches that use customer response and performance data to improve content, channels, sequencing, and future engagement
Turn performance findings into clear strategic implications and optimization recommendations

Client, Growth & Team Leadership

Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior clients and lead executive presentations, workshops, and high-stakes strategic conversations
Lead engagement and omnichannel strategy for pitches, organic growth opportunities, and capability development
Manage, mentor, and develop strategists while raising the quality, consistency, and visibility of BGBx's Engagement Strategy offering

Qualifications

10+ years of relevant experience across engagement strategy, omnichannel strategy, experience planning, digital strategy, CRM strategy, integrated strategy, or related disciplines
Significant pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences experience, preferably in an agency, communications, or consulting environment
Proven ability to lead complex engagement strategy from audience insight and problem definition through activation, measurement, and optimization
Strong understanding of HCP and patient journeys and the strategic roles of media, CRM, digital, social, field engagement, data, analytics, experience design, and marketing technology
Fluency in how personalization, marketing automation, modular content, next-best action, and decisioning can support omnichannel engagement
Strong client leadership, facilitation, executive communication, and strategic storytelling skills
Experience leading pitches, growing client relationships, and managing or developing strategists
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory, privacy, consent, and compliance considerations

Preferred Experience

Experience across both HCP and patient engagement and across launch, growth, or mature brand challenges
Experience translating global strategy into locally relevant engagement approaches
Practical experience with advanced segmentation, dynamic personalization, closed-loop marketing, or AI-enabled planning and optimization
Experience building or evolving an engagement, omnichannel, digital, or experience strategy capability

Interview Process

Candidates will be invited to discuss two anonymized examples of work they personally led, including one demonstrating end-to-end omnichannel strategy. We are most interested in problem framing, strategic choices, cross-functional leadership, measurement, and impact. Confidential client information and unpaid speculative work are not required.

Salary Range:
$200,000 - $240,000 CAD

The salary range provided represents what a potential hire may expect to earn in this role at BGBx. Actual salary decisions will be influenced by several factors that we use to determine overall fit, including experience (both direct and indirect), education, training, demonstrated qualifications, and organizational need. Salary is only one component of the total rewards package offered at BGBx.

What We Offer

At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.

Our benefits package typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers. Additional benefits may be available based on your location. Beyond benefits, you'll find a culture built on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on healthcare and the people it serves.

BGBx is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status or any category or class of person protected by law.

jobs.title: Director of Finance - Global Services & Aftermarket
jobs.description:
Our client is a global leader in advanced manufacturing technology, specializing in high-performance injection molding systems and solutions used across packaging, consumer goods, medical, pharmaceutical, and other industries. With a history spanning more than 70 years and customers in over 140 countries, the company combines engineering, automation, and manufacturing innovation to help leading organizations improve productivity, quality, and efficiency.

Type: Full-Time
Location: Bolton, ON
Range: $200,000 – $230,000

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of the Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business
strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience in a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Director of Finance
Status: Active

The Company:

Exclusive Floors is British Columbia’s largest provider and installer of flooring and tile and a long-standing leader in the industry, with an exceptional reputation in the market. For over 40 years, the company has served builders, developers, designers and homeowners with exceptional service, deep product expertise and industry-leading installation quality. Exclusive Floors is searching for a Director of Finance to strengthen financial leadership, provide greater insight into business performance, and help build the systems and processes needed to support continued profitable growth.

The Role:

The Director of Finance will be a visible and influential leader across the organization, with full ownership of the day-to-day finance function. As a key member of the leadership team, this person will lead and develop an experienced finance team, ensure accurate and timely reporting, and bring financial insight and sound judgment to business decisions. The Director will have a key leadership role in the implementation of NetSuite, strengthen financial processes and controls, manage risk, and provide the insight needed to support the company’s continued growth.

The Responsibilities:

Take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, including financial reporting, payables, collections, cash management and financial discipline.
Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, including monthly statements, cash flow reporting and executive reporting.
Lead annual budgeting and forecasting, providing clear visibility into business drivers and expected results.
Develop meaningful financial and operating KPIs that provide leadership with timely insight into performance.
Be a strategic finance partner to the President and leadership team, bringing financial insight and sound judgment to key business decisions.
Analyze profitability, costs, trends and growth opportunities, translating financial information into clear recommendations.
Partner with sales and operations to support profitable growth while managing financial and contractual risk.
Provide financial oversight of project-based work, including project accounting, progress billing, collections, credit risk, lien timelines and contractual obligations.
Maintain strong internal controls and oversee audit, compliance, insurance and other financial risk-management activities.
Identify financial and contractual risks early and work collaboratively with the business to develop practical solutions.
Have a key leadership role in the successful implementation of NetSuite, working with internal and external resources.
Use NetSuite to strengthen and standardize financial processes, reporting and data quality while reducing manual work and improving scalability.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and efficiency across the organization.

The Requirements:

10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including senior-level responsibility for a finance function and team.
CPA designation preferred, combined with strong technical accounting expertise in financial reporting, controls, cash flow and risk management. Experience working in public practice is a strong asset.
Proven people leader with the ability to lead and develop an experienced finance team, build trust and create accountability.
Construction or closely related project-based industry experience, with practical knowledge of project accounting, contracts, credit and collections, lien timelines and financial risk.
Excellent communication, listening and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance, sales, operations, senior leadership and ownership.
A visible, approachable and collaborative leadership style, with the ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment and take full ownership of the finance function.
Strong strategic and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to interpret financial information, identify trends, risks and opportunities, and translate the numbers into meaningful business insight.
Solid business judgment, with the ability to manage financial and contractual risk while working collaboratively with sales and operations to support profitable growth.
Demonstrated experience improving financial systems, processes, controls and reporting to create greater efficiency, consistency and scalability.
Successful track record leading or playing a significant role in an ERP implementation, NetSuite implementation experience is a strong asset.
Experience supporting a business through growth and change, including organic growth, acquisitions or times of significant business evolution.
Strong financial planning and analysis capabilities, including budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis and performance reporting.

Our goal at People First Solutions is to hire top performers for our clients. To this end, our selection process is thorough, enabling us to collect very detailed information. We base our selection process on Topgrading®, a proven method that allows our clients’ to effectively match top performing candidates to key leadership roles. As well, we integrate TalentSorter®, a behavioural science based assessment tool to help companies hire for “fit.”
If you possess the fundamental skills, experience and education required to be successful in this role we invite you to provide a cover letter and résumé in PDF, in confidence to either Bob Murray or Adrienne Giffen.
Bob Murray – bob@peoplefirstsolutions.com – 604.803.4377
Adrienne Giffen – adrienne@peoplefirstsolutions.com – 604.209.8023

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
About Jim Peplinski Capital

At most companies, finance supports the business. At Jim Peplinski Capital (JPC), finance is our business.

For over 35 years, Jim Peplinski Capital has financed and managed the vehicles and equipment Canadian businesses run on. We combine capital, fleet expertise and technology to help our clients get the most from the assets that keep them moving. Now we're building the next generation of fleet management, with ambitious growth plans and the balance sheet to pursue them.

We're looking for a steady, strategic, and commercially minded CFO to partner with the President and Executive Team on the decisions and execution that shape our future.

About The Role

Reporting directly to the President, you'll lead JPC's Finance, Credit and Risk function and serve as a trusted partner to the Executive Team. Two leaders report to you, a Finance Manager and a Credit Manager, along with their teams.

This is not a back-office finance role. As a lender and fleet manager, how we fund, price and manage risk is how we compete, and you'll own it. That covers capital and liquidity, funding and banking relationships, pricing and return on capital, portfolio risk and credit discipline, financial reporting and planning, and accounting, controls and compliance.

You'll shape how JPC funds its growth, manages risk, allocates capital, and you'll build the people and systems we need to scale. It's hands-on leadership: you set the direction, and you’ll roll up your sleeves when the work calls for it.

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership. Build, mentor and develop high-performing Finance and Credit teams with a culture of sound judgment, ownership, accountability and practical problem solving.
Capital, Funding and Liquidity. Ensure JPC has the capital, liquidity and funding structure to support growth. You'll manage banking relationships, funding facilities, interest rate exposure, covenant compliance and lender reporting, and build capacity ahead of where the business is going.
Residuals and Portfolio Risk. You'll own concentration limits, provisioning and credit performance across the portfolio. Collaborating with our VP, Asset Management, you'll set and monitor residual assumptions.
Credit and Adjudication. Keep credit discipline strong while finding practical ways to say yes to good business. You'll be the second set of eyes for the Credit Manager on the decisions that need it.
Financial Reporting and Planning. Deliver accurate, timely reporting to the President, Board and lenders. You'll lead budgeting, forecasting and planning, and provide the Executive Team the insights to make better decisions faster.
Accounting, Compliance and Controls. Own accounting, lease accounting, tax, audit, treasury and financial controls, plus our regulatory program, including FINTRAC and AML.
Client engagement. Work directly with clients on the decisions that matter most, from structuring deals to managing delinquencies and payment workouts, balancing a strong relationship with protecting the portfolio.
Commercial Judgment. Bring financial rigor to decisions on new products, services and partner programs. You'll lead negotiation of key commercial agreements and embed financial and risk thinking across JPC.
Systems & Technology: Own the finance and credit systems that support our growth, driving automation and building a scalable foundation for reporting, adjudication and accounting.

What We’re Looking For

You have 12+ years of progressive finance experience, including senior leadership. Experience in fleet management, automotive and/or equipment finance or specialty lending is a strong asset. Bank or boutique, we care about the depth of your experience, not the logo. A CPA is preferred but not required for candidates with deep experience as a CFO or senior finance leader in a lending business.

You Also

Have built teams, developed strong leaders, and held them to a high standard.
Understand banking, lending, capital structure and liquidity management.
Have excellent financial, accounting and commercial credit judgment.
Are an expert in assessing financial performance, cash flow, leverage and creditworthiness.
Turn financial information into clear recommendations and decisions.
Can protect the balance sheet without losing sight of the customer and commercial opportunities.
Take ownership, challenge assumptions and make decisions.

Why You’ll Love It At JPC

A real partnership. You'll work directly with the President, Executive Team and Board. We're privately held, so decisions get made quickly, and you'll be part of making them.
Autonomy to build. You'll have the autonomy to build our Finance, Credit and Risk function, influence strategy and create processes that scale.
A chance to shape the industry. You'll help define how commercial fleets are financed and optimized.
A team that plays to win. You'll join a talented, fast-moving group that values ownership, high standards and trust.
Strong rewards. Competitive compensation, a performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits from day one.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

At BGBx
, we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges.

Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day.

If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx.

Position Overview

The VP, Engagement Strategy turns brand strategy into connected omnichannel engagement.
This senior leader defines how audience insight, behavioral science, content, media, CRM, field engagement, technology, and measurement work together across the customer journey. The VP leads clients and integrated teams from insight through activation and optimization, while helping grow BGBx's Engagement Strategy capability.

Key Responsibilities

Engagement & Omnichannel Strategy

Lead audience-centered, behaviorally informed omnichannel strategies across HCP, patient, caregiver, payer, and other stakeholder audiences
Translate brand and business strategy into connected journeys, engagement architectures, channel roles, sequencing, triggers, and activation roadmaps
Define how content, media, CRM, field, social, experiential, and digital interactions work together to move audiences toward desired behaviors
Make clear strategic choices and tradeoffs that focus investment on the moments and interactions most likely to create impact

Audience, Content & Experience

Turn research, segmentation, behavioral data, cultural context, and market dynamics into actionable audience understanding
Identify the beliefs, motivations, barriers, decision pathways, and moments of receptivity that engagement must address
Shape content and experience strategy so each interaction has a clear role, purpose, call to action, and connection to what happens next
Maintain the strategic throughline as work moves from strategy into creative development, implementation, and optimization

Measurement & Optimization

Define engagement objectives, KPI frameworks, signal plans, and learning agendas
Design closed-loop approaches that use customer response and performance data to improve content, channels, sequencing, and future engagement
Turn performance findings into clear strategic implications and optimization recommendations

Client, Growth & Team Leadership

Serve as a trusted strategic partner to senior clients and lead executive presentations, workshops, and high-stakes strategic conversations
Lead engagement and omnichannel strategy for pitches, organic growth opportunities, and capability development
Manage, mentor, and develop strategists while raising the quality, consistency, and visibility of BGBx's Engagement Strategy offering

Qualifications

10+ years of relevant experience across engagement strategy, omnichannel strategy, experience planning, digital strategy, CRM strategy, integrated strategy, or related disciplines
Significant pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences experience, preferably in an agency, communications, or consulting environment
Proven ability to lead complex engagement strategy from audience insight and problem definition through activation, measurement, and optimization
Strong understanding of HCP and patient journeys and the strategic roles of media, CRM, digital, social, field engagement, data, analytics, experience design, and marketing technology
Fluency in how personalization, marketing automation, modular content, next-best action, and decisioning can support omnichannel engagement
Strong client leadership, facilitation, executive communication, and strategic storytelling skills
Experience leading pitches, growing client relationships, and managing or developing strategists
Working knowledge of pharmaceutical regulatory, privacy, consent, and compliance considerations

Preferred Experience

Experience across both HCP and patient engagement and across launch, growth, or mature brand challenges
Experience translating global strategy into locally relevant engagement approaches
Practical experience with advanced segmentation, dynamic personalization, closed-loop marketing, or AI-enabled planning and optimization
Experience building or evolving an engagement, omnichannel, digital, or experience strategy capability

Interview Process

Candidates will be invited to discuss two anonymized examples of work they personally led, including one demonstrating end-to-end omnichannel strategy. We are most interested in problem framing, strategic choices, cross-functional leadership, measurement, and impact. Confidential client information and unpaid speculative work are not required.

Salary Range:
$200,000 - $240,000 CAD

The salary range provided represents what a potential hire may expect to earn in this role at BGBx. Actual salary decisions will be influenced by several factors that we use to determine overall fit, including experience (both direct and indirect), education, training, demonstrated qualifications, and organizational need. Salary is only one component of the total rewards package offered at BGBx.

What We Offer

At BGBx, we invest in our people because exceptional talent drives exceptional work. We provide a competitive rewards package designed to support your health, well-being, professional growth, and life outside of work.

Our benefits package typically includes health care insurance, retirement plans, generous paid time off and holidays, wellness benefits, life insurance, learning and development opportunities, and other resources that support our employees throughout their careers. Additional benefits may be available based on your location. Beyond benefits, you'll find a culture built on collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on healthcare and the people it serves.

BGBx is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status or any category or class of person protected by law.

new_jobs.description:
Our client is a global leader in advanced manufacturing technology, specializing in high-performance injection molding systems and solutions used across packaging, consumer goods, medical, pharmaceutical, and other industries. With a history spanning more than 70 years and customers in over 140 countries, the company combines engineering, automation, and manufacturing innovation to help leading organizations improve productivity, quality, and efficiency.

Location: Bolton, ON
Range: $200,000 – $230,000

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of the Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business
strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience in a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

The Director will have a key leadership role in the implementation of NetSuite, strengthen financial processes and controls, manage risk, and provide the insight needed to support the company’s continued growth.

The Responsibilities:

Take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, including financial reporting, payables, collections, cash management and financial discipline.
Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting, including monthly statements, cash flow reporting and executive reporting.
Lead annual budgeting and forecasting, providing clear visibility into business drivers and expected results.
Develop meaningful financial and operating KPIs that provide leadership with timely insight into performance.
Be a strategic finance partner to the President and leadership team, bringing financial insight and sound judgment to key business decisions.
Analyze profitability, costs, trends and growth opportunities, translating financial information into clear recommendations.
Partner with sales and operations to support profitable growth while managing financial and contractual risk.
Provide financial oversight of project-based work, including project accounting, progress billing, collections, credit risk, lien timelines and contractual obligations.
Maintain strong internal controls and oversee audit, compliance, insurance and other financial risk-management activities.
Identify financial and contractual risks early and work collaboratively with the business to develop practical solutions.
Have a key leadership role in the successful implementation of NetSuite, working with internal and external resources.
Use NetSuite to strengthen and standardize financial processes, reporting and data quality while reducing manual work and improving scalability.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and efficiency across the organization.

The Requirements:

10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including senior-level responsibility for a finance function and team.
CPA designation preferred, combined with strong technical accounting expertise in financial reporting, controls, cash flow and risk management. Experience working in public practice is a strong asset.
Proven people leader with the ability to lead and develop an experienced finance team, build trust and create accountability.
Construction or closely related project-based industry experience, with practical knowledge of project accounting, contracts, credit and collections, lien timelines and financial risk.
Excellent communication, listening and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively across finance, sales, operations, senior leadership and ownership.
A visible, approachable and collaborative leadership style, with the ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment and take full ownership of the finance function.
Strong strategic and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to interpret financial information, identify trends, risks and opportunities, and translate the numbers into meaningful business insight.
Solid business judgment, with the ability to manage financial and contractual risk while working collaboratively with sales and operations to support profitable growth.
Demonstrated experience improving financial systems, processes, controls and reporting to create greater efficiency, consistency and scalability.
Successful track record leading or playing a significant role in an ERP implementation, NetSuite implementation experience is a strong asset.
Experience supporting a business through growth and change, including organic growth, acquisitions or times of significant business evolution.
Strong financial planning and analysis capabilities, including budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis and performance reporting.
